description: The partnership aims to position Uttar Pradesh as a key hub for artificial intelligence by expanding AI-focused infrastructure, skilling initiatives and startup support under the IndiaAI Mission framework.
body_lead: IndiaAI Mission, UPDESCO sign MoU to boost AI ecosystem in UP The partnership aims to position Uttar Pradesh as a key hub for artificial intelligence by expanding AI-focused infrastructure, skilling initiatives and startup support under the IndiaAI Mission framework.
